name: re8ch-platform-tools
description: Governed read-only platform health and inventory tools published through ToolHive.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect approved RE8CH platform health safely.
interface.longDescription: Read-only Kubernetes inventory, tenant metrics, and fixed health checks for Harbor, ToolHive Registry, Grafana, Headlamp, CloudBeaver, and Pigsty-backed database routes. Production access remains OAuth-gated.
defaultPrompt: Check RE8CH platform health and summarize current failures.
List my tenant workloads and highlight unavailable deployments.
Compare database routes and recommend a healthy read/write path.
